strategies.summary: In the London kill zone, trade toward the opposing 4h swing after a 4h PD array is tapped: enter on a new 5m FVG if Asia expanded, or on the ST model's second FVG if Asia consolidated. The stop goes beyond the intermediate-term extreme that leaves no unmitigated 15m or 1h FVG beyond it.

timeframes.notes: 4h PD array context, 15m/1h for stop placement, 5m execution. With daily PD arrays the presenter scales the entry timeframe up without naming it (resolve with the contract ladder: ladder_up(entry_tf, 1)).

glossary.Intermediate term high (stop): In this plan, the swing extreme beyond which no unmitigated 15m or 1h FVG remains; see custom_signals.intermediate_term_low_stop (bullish side).

custom_signals.name: htf_pd_array_tap
custom_signals.plain_definition: Price trades into a higher-timeframe discount array (bullish) or premium array (bearish), such as a fair value gap or order block.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: (low <= bullish_fvg[0].gap_high@bias_tf AND high >= bullish_fvg[0].gap_low@bias_tf AND NOT bullish_fvg[0].filled@bias_tf) OR (low <= bullish_ob[0].zone_high@bias_tf AND high >= bullish_ob[0].zone_low@bias_tf AND NOT bullish_ob[0].invalidated@bias_tf)

custom_signals.name: london_kz_entry_trigger
custom_signals.plain_definition: In the London kill zone: if Asia expanded in the trade direction, any new fair value gap in the trade direction; if Asia consolidated, the second fair value gap of the ST model.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: kill_zone == london AND ((custom_signals.asia_expansion AND bullish_fvg[0].formed) OR (custom_signals.asia_consolidation AND custom_signals.st_model))

custom_signals.name: asia_expansion
custom_signals.plain_definition: The Asian session expands away from the higher-timeframe PD array and leaves fair value gaps in its leg.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: count(bullish_fvg[0].formed AND ny_minute >= 20:00, ny_minute / tf_minutes + 240 / tf_minutes + 1) >= 1

custom_signals.name: asia_consolidation
custom_signals.plain_definition: The Asian session stays in a tight range without expansion.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: count((bullish_fvg[0].formed OR bearish_fvg[0].formed) AND ny_minute >= 20:00, ny_minute / tf_minutes + 240 / tf_minutes + 1) == 0

custom_signals.name: st_model
custom_signals.plain_definition: Displacement, retracement, displacement: a first FVG forms, price retraces into it without closing through it, then a second same-direction FVG forms; entry is on the second.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: bullish_fvg[0].formed AND bullish_fvg[1].confirmed_at >= open_time - K_ST_MAX_CANDLES * (tf_minutes * 60000) AND lowest(low[-1], (open_time - bullish_fvg[1].confirmed_at) / (tf_minutes * 60000) - 1) <= bullish_fvg[1].gap_high AND NOT bullish_fvg[1].filled

custom_signals.name: fvg_touched
custom_signals.plain_definition: Price trades into the fair value gap (a touch or sting), without requiring the consequent encroachment.

custom_signals.name: intermediate_term_low_stop
custom_signals.plain_definition: The stop reference beyond which no unmitigated 15m or 1h fair value gap remains (the low that covers higher-timeframe imbalances).
custom_signals.numeric_definition: min(swing_low[0].price, bullish_fvg[0].gap_low@15m * (1 - bullish_fvg[0].filled@15m) + swing_low[0].price * bullish_fvg[0].filled@15m, bullish_fvg[0].gap_low@1h * (1 - bullish_fvg[0].filled@1h) + swing_low[0].price * bullish_fvg[0].filled@1h)

sequence: Wait for price to tap the 4h discount array that points to the opposing 4h swing high.
On 5m, mark the new bullish FVG.
Accept it only inside London and if Asia expanded up; if Asia consolidated it must be the ST model's second FVG.
Buy the first retracement into that FVG.

invalidation.text: The setup is invalidated if price closes above the intermediate term high chosen for stop loss placement.
Do not place a tight stop loss immediately above a 5-minute high if an unmitigated 15-minute or 1-hour fair value gap hovers above it.
invalidation.numeric_definition: (NOT bullish_fvg[0].filled@15m AND bullish_fvg[0].gap_low@15m < swing_low[0].price) OR (NOT bullish_fvg[0].filled@1h AND bullish_fvg[0].gap_low@1h < swing_low[0].price)

filters.text: Focus primarily on Forex pairs; indices have different characteristics and require a separate strategy.
Do not use a 5-minute entry timeframe when executing off Daily PD arrays; scale up the entry timeframe for higher-timeframe arrays.
The entry timeframe must always be traded in context with the timeframes directly above it (5m in concert with 15m and 1h).

entry_rule.text: In London, enter long on the first retracement into the new bullish FVG (the second FVG when the ST model is required).
entry_rule.quote: all I need to see in London is a new bearish fair value Gap then I enter on the overlapping PD array

target_rule.text: Target the opposing 4h swing high (premium array).
target_rule.quote: what is our Target our Target is this swing low on the four hour that is your discount rate

stop_rule.text: Stop below the intermediate-term low that leaves no unmitigated 15m or 1h FVG below it.
stop_rule.quote: you cover these highs price has no reason to come back there which on the 5 minutes is this intermediate term high

management.notes: A re-entry is valid if price produces another bearish FVG and establishes a new intermediate term high, targeting the same 4-hour discount low.

presenter_claims.claim: All concepts including AMD, Power of 3, Midnight Open, New Week Opening Gap, Enigma, and Reaper are inherently integrated into this simple trading plan without needing to track them individually.
The hard work is done on the higher timeframe; on the lower timeframe you are merely getting in sync.

strategies.notes: Whether Asia expands or consolidates does not invalidate the trade; it decides between the first London FVG and the ST model's second FVG. Required bias is the presenter's HTF draw (4h array reaction), not the engine structure bias. Written on the bullish side; the presenter's examples are bearish (mirror). A re-entry is valid on another FVG with a new intermediate-term extreme toward the same 4h target.

setup_walkthrough.what_happens: Price pushes up to form an intermediate term high that covers higher timeframe FVGs.
Strong bearish displacement creates a new 5m bearish fair value gap during the London Killzone.
Price retraces into the newly formed London FVG, mitigating it and triggering the short entry.

examples.presenter_commentary: The presenter highlights that because Asia expanded downward and created its own FVGs, we simply wait for London to print a continuation FVG. He heavily emphasizes placing the stop above an 'intermediate term high' that protects against unmitigated 15m/1h arrays, rather than the immediate 5m swing high.

may_differ.reason: Presenter uses 'overlapping PD array' loosely without strictly defining if it's an OB or FVG on the exact same timeframe.

uncertainties.why: The video resolution and chart zoom do not allow precise reading of the right-side Y-axis or the exact calendar date. Values were reverse-engineered structurally to respect the 1:3 RR described.

signals_observed.bias_source: 4-hour fair value gap targeting 4-hour swing low

setup_walkthrough.what_happens: Price displaces lower to form the first bearish FVG after tapping the 4-hour premium array.
Price retraces into the first bearish FVG.
Price displaces down a second time, leaving a second bearish FVG.
Price retraces into the second FVG, mitigating it and triggering the ST model short entry.

examples.presenter_commentary: The presenter highlights this 'classic' London setup where Asia is trapped in consolidation. He shows how waiting for the two-stage ST model keeps you safe, yielding a 1:4 RR trade to the same 4H target.
